entry.question:
## Physical scenario

A convex meniscus lens is made from glass with \(n = 1.50\). The radius of curvature of the convex surface (left in figure) is \(22\,\mathrm{cm}\). The surface on the right is concave with radius of curvature \(46\,\mathrm{cm}\).

## Question

What is the focal length?

## Answer choices

- A: A: 0.72m

- B: B: 0.78m

- C: C: 0.84m

- D: D: 0.92m

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)

The image depicts a lens diagram showing a biconcave lens. The lens is shaded in light blue and has two radii marked, labeled as \( R_1 = 22 \, \text{cm} \) and \( R_2 = -46 \, \text{cm} \). 

Points \( C_1 \) and \( C_2 \) are indicated; \( C_1 \) is between the lens and the divergent surface, representing the center of curvature related to \( R_1 \), and \( C_2 \) is on the opposite side, representing the center of curvature related to \( R_2 \). Arrows and lines connect these points to the lens surface, showing the directions of the radii. The figure illustrates the geometry of the lens’ curved surfaces.
